fields.name: account
fields.description: The rider's login (username). Row access compares it with $user.id.

fields.name: paymentToken
fields.description: Demo card token at the payment provider. A real app stores the provider's customer/payment-method id here, never a card number.

fields.name: ratingAvg
fields.description: Average of driverStars over this driver's rides (rollup).

fields.name: ridesAccepted
fields.description: Rides still linked to this driver = accepted ones (an expired/declined offer unlinks the driver).

fields.name: cancelRate
fields.description: Share of accepted rides this driver cancelled (0..1). The tiny constant avoids a division by zero.

fields.name: fareCents
fields.description: Base R$3.00 + R$1.20/km + R$0.25/min, times the surge. tripMinutes is filled by the road route (stage 70); before that it counts as 0.

fields.name: riderAccount
fields.description: Login of the rider who asked for this ride. A rider can only create rides for themself (row write rule).

fields.name: driverAccount
fields.description: Login of the assigned driver; set by the platform when a driver is matched.

fields.name: driverStars
fields.description: The rider's rating of the driver (1-5).

fields.name: riderStars
fields.description: The driver's rating of the rider (1-5).

fields.name: expiredFlag
fields.description: 1 when the driver let the offer run out; summed into Driver.missedOffers (stage 50).

fields.name: source
fields.description: Card token at the provider (demo: tok_ok, tok_async, tok_decline, tok_flaky, tok_nowebhook...).

fields.name: peakMultiplier
fields.description: Switched by the PeakOn/PeakOff cron flows; 1.0 outside peak hours.

fields.name: peakValue
fields.description: What peakMultiplier becomes during peak hours.

procedures.name: MatchDriver
procedures.description: Offers the ride to the closest AVAILABLE driver not tried before. Reads the ride fresh, so a ride the rider cancelled meanwhile is left alone. Creates a RideOffer, holds the driver as BUSY and moves the ride to ASSIGNED. Finding nobody leaves the ride REQUESTED (the flow decides when to give up). Drivers already offered this ride (its RideOffer rows) are skipped.

args.title: New ride offer
args.body: Pickup ${pickupDistanceKm} km away. Open your tasks and accept within 20 seconds.

procedures.name: ReleaseOffer
procedures.description: Shared by the timeout and the decline paths: frees the driver, clears the driver from the ride and puts the ride back to REQUESTED so the next attempt can offer it to someone else. Does nothing when the ride is no longer ASSIGNED (cancelled or accepted meanwhile).

procedures.name: ExpireOffer
procedures.description: awaitEvent timeout path: the driver did not answer in time.

procedures.name: AcceptOffer
procedures.description: The driver answered ACCEPT in time: offer ACCEPTED, ride ACCEPTED.

args.title: Your driver is on the way

procedures.name: GiveUp
procedures.description: After the last attempt: a ride still REQUESTED ends as NO_DRIVER.

args.title: No driver available
args.body: Nobody accepted your ride. Please try again in a few minutes.

procedures.name: ReadRide
procedures.description: Returns the ride as it is now (the flow's answer).

procedures.name: MeasureTrip
procedures.description: Trip length and time by road (OSRM). On any routing error: straight line x 1.3 at 30 km/h, marked 'estimate'.

procedures.name: OfferCandidates
procedures.description: The drivers free right now (at most 3 are offered the ride, one after another).

procedures.name: CreatePayment
procedures.description: Creates the PENDING Payment for a COMPLETED ride: amount = the ride's fare, card = the rider's token.

procedures.name: ChargePayment
procedures.description: One charge attempt. succeeded -> CAPTURED; processing -> PROCESSING (the webhook decides later); a transient error (timeout, 429, 5xx) -> RETRYING while attempts < 3; anything else (a decline) -> FAILED with the provider's code. Never throws: the error is captured by errorTarget (K3).

procedures.name: ApplyPaymentUpdate
procedures.description: Applies the provider's webhook (PaymentUpdated) to a PROCESSING payment. A late or repeated webhook for a payment already final changes nothing.

procedures.name: MarkPaymentReview
procedures.description: awaitEvent timeout: no webhook arrived in time; a person must look (Dispatcher).

procedures.name: PriceRide
procedures.description: Works out the ride's surge multiplier (zone x peak x demand) and stores the parts on the ride, so the rider and the Dispatcher can see WHY a price is what it is.

procedures.name: SetPeak
procedures.description: Peak hours start: every zone's peakMultiplier becomes its peakValue.

procedures.name: ClearPeak
procedures.description: Peak hours end: every zone's peakMultiplier goes back to 1.0.

procedures.name: AfterCancel
procedures.description: Runs after a ride was CANCELLED: frees its driver (if any) and tells the other side.

procedures.name: NotifyPaymentResult
procedures.description: Tells the rider how the payment ended.

args.title: Receipt: R$ ${amountCents} cents paid
args.body: Thank you for riding with us.

args.title: Payment problem (${status})
args.body: We could not charge your card yet. Code: ${failureCode}.

procedures.name: RemindToRate
procedures.description: 10 minutes after the trip: if the rider has not rated the driver yet, remind them.

args.title: How was your trip with ${driverName}?
args.body: Rate your driver from 1 to 5 stars.
